headline: Sensex and Nifty surge over 1.6% as markets rally for fourth consecutive day led by FMCG and auto

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex jumped 1,225 points to close at 23,811 on November 3
Nifty 50 reclaimed the 23,800 level with a rally of over 1.6%
Strong buying interest was seen in auto, FMCG, and private banking sectors
The market maintained positive momentum for the fourth consecutive trading session
whatHappening: Benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty ended significantly higher in the latest session
FMCG stocks led the market gains as the top sectoral performer
Indian investors reported a Rs 100-crore loss due to unauthorized stock swaps on Stockal
Motorola teased the launch of its Signature 27 smartphone model in India
summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty witnessed a strong rally, gaining over 1.6% to reach new recent highs. The surge was led by robust performance in the FMCG, auto, and private banking sectors over a four-day winning streak. Meanwhile, Indian investors reported concerns over unauthorized international stock swaps on a trading platform.
